blind_spots.risk: The repo does not contain the actual canonical order-668 64-modular seed or its generator quadruple.
blind_spots.impact: Several of the strongest CA repair concepts stay at the design stage until that seed is reconstructed or recovered.

blind_spots.risk: Locality may be an artifact of the chosen compressed representation rather than a real property of the order-668 search space.
blind_spots.impact: A CA may appear effective in one coordinate system but collapse under canonicalization or symmetry changes.

blind_spots.risk: Some concepts can quietly leak back into known Williamson, Turyn, or fully circulant families.
blind_spots.impact: A method may still be useful operationally but should then be relabeled as optimizer-over-known-family rather than a new search paradigm.

blind_spots.risk: Learned or tensor-assisted methods may look strong on small orders and fail to transfer to the 167-core regime.
blind_spots.impact: The concept cards intentionally emphasize transfer tests and seed-matched baselines as kill criteria.

blind_spots.risk: The order-668 open status could change after the 2025 frontier paper.
blind_spots.impact: Any external-facing claim about novelty or openness should be re-verified before publication or implementation claims are made.

anomaly_results.constraint: Remove access to the 64-modular seed and force random starts only.
anomaly_results.interpretation: The strongest defect-repair ideas are seed-dependent; without a near-solution, the search shifts toward seed generation or learned generic repair.

anomaly_results.constraint: Require strict reversibility or number conservation in the CA rules.
anomaly_results.interpretation: Generative and finite-field rule-search directions benefit from explicit conservation laws, while learned and solver-hybrid variants become much narrower.

anomaly_results.constraint: Disallow any trajectory that converges into a standard Williamson or fully circulant family.
anomaly_results.interpretation: Several promising channels remain valid only as seed generators unless they can prove they stay outside already-explored structured families.

anomaly_results.constraint: Limit neighborhoods to radius 1 and favor GPU or FPGA friendly updates.
anomaly_results.interpretation: Hardware-friendly locality favors pure CA and decoder-style ideas, while tensor-heavy lookahead becomes harder to justify.
